fetched_title: Selecting or Solving? What Best-of-N Verification Delivers in Video Reasoning
summary: Defines Selection Increment (selection accuracy minus the same verifier's accuracy with candidates withheld) for best-of-N video reasoning, and shows a weak verifier can gain from candidates yet fall below majority vote. Full-text search found no all-incorrect pool condition, so it is not an L1 test.
venue_clean: NeurIPS 2026 VLM4WRD workshop (per arXiv comments); arXiv:2611.00507
